headline: U.S. equity and fixed-income markets remained officially closed on Thursday, November 26, 2026, in observance of the Thanksgiving Day federal holiday. With the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and NASDAQ halted for the full session, domestic cash clearing matrices recorded zero regular-hours volume, leaving all major U.S. benchmarks unchanged from Wednesday's closing baselines. Sovereign debt trading was similarly suspended, keeping the benchmark 10-year U.S. Treasury yield static at 4.95%. In thinned international electronic trading, Brent crude oil futures drifted quietly near $93.20 a barrel as global energy desks awaited OPEC+ production commentary and Friday's U.S. trading resumption.
